items.summary: Redesign the Admin Dashboard page (AdminPage.tsx) layout to professional standards: use a clean two-column or sidebar-main layout with clear visual hierarchy, consistent spacing, section headings, and card-based panels for each tab's content area.

Redesign the 'Add New Product' section in AdminProductForm.tsx as a clean, well-aligned card: use a single cohesive card container with proper label/input alignment (grid or flex layout), consistent input sizing, grouped sections (e.g., basic info, pricing, media), and clear visual separation between fields.

Fix the Barcode field in AdminProductForm.tsx to be fully functional: the barcode input must accept manual text entry, and the camera-based BarcodeScanner integration must correctly populate the barcode field value when a code is scanned. Ensure the scanned value is bound to the form state.

Fix the 'Add Product' button in AdminProductForm.tsx so it does not get stuck in the 'Adding Product...' loading state. Ensure the mutation's loading/pending state is properly reset on both success and error, the button returns to its default state after the operation completes, and success/error feedback is shown to the user.
